articles.title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
articles.snippet: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

articles.title: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
articles.snippet: Security experts said attackers could have drained Binance’s wallets without EIP-7702, but the Ethereum upgrade may have helped bypass withdrawal safeguards.

articles.title: Binance hacker’s Bitcoin haul tops Coinbase’s corporate treasury
articles.snippet: The attackers held 18,270 BTC early Friday, topping Coinbase’s reported corporate holdings, and an Ether stash exceeding 500,000 ETH.

articles.title: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
articles.snippet: Binance said attackers may have used a compromised DevOps laptop to access internal infrastructure.

articles.title: Binance Hack: Why Bitcoin Didn't Crash Like It Did in 2018
articles.snippet: Binance lost about $6.4 billion, the largest crypto hack on record, yet Bitcoin fell about 3%, against nearly 11% in 2018 when the exchange was last attacked.
